scope: Explicit sanitized exports and source snapshots only; no private raw files or binaries.
checks: All attachment members decoded as UTF-8
No known private binding source addresses or original resource URL
No personal paths, link-local/private IPv4 or signed URL patterns
No absolute capture timestamps or local interface numbers in exported JSON/JSONL
Private raw-log identifiers and hashes retained only in local originals
Initial-window timestamps share one relative origin, preserving all cross-file offsets
retained: Relative request timing and complete failure counts
historicalSourceException: Unmodified historical source retains its fixed planned deadline constant; this is not a captured event time.
